description: Pod to pod network flows and TCP health captured with eBPF by OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI) and stored in Azure Data Explorer.

panels.description: Rate of the OBI cumulative counter obi.network.flow.bytes, broken down by peer workload. A flow between two nodes is observed by the OBI agent on each end, so cross node traffic is reported once per observing node.

targets.query:
OTELMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where MetricName == "obi.network.flow.bytes"
| extend SrcNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.namespace"])
| extend SrcWorkload = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.owner.name"])
| extend DstNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.namespace"])
| extend DstWorkload = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.owner.name"])
| extend NodeID = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["host.id"])
| where DstNamespace == "${namespace}" and DstWorkload == "${workload}"
| extend Peer = iff(isempty(SrcWorkload), "external", strcat(SrcNamespace, "/", SrcWorkload))
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(NodeID, "|", Peer)
| summarize Counter = max(MetricValue) by SeriesKey, Peer, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m)
| order by SeriesKey asc, Bucket asc
| serialize
| extend PrevKey = prev(SeriesKey), PrevCounter = prev(Counter), PrevBucket = prev(Bucket)
| where PrevKey == SeriesKey and Counter >= PrevCounter
| extend Seconds = todouble(datetime_diff('second', Bucket, PrevBucket))
| where Seconds > 0
| summarize BytesPerSecond = sum((Counter - PrevCounter) / Seconds) by Timestamp = Bucket, Peer
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Packets sent by ${workload} in ${namespace}

panels.description: Total bytes exchanged over the selected time range for every workload pair touching namespace ${namespace}.

targets.query:
OTELMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where MetricName == "obi.network.flow.bytes"
| extend SrcNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.namespace"])
| extend SrcWorkload = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.owner.name"])
| extend DstNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.namespace"])
| extend DstWorkload = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.owner.name"])
| extend NodeID = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["host.id"])
| where SrcNamespace == "${namespace}" or DstNamespace == "${namespace}"
| extend Source = iff(isempty(SrcWorkload), "external", strcat(SrcNamespace, "/", SrcWorkload))
| extend Destination = iff(isempty(DstWorkload), "external", strcat(DstNamespace, "/", DstWorkload))
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(NodeID, "|", Source, "|", Destination)
| summarize Counter = max(MetricValue) by SeriesKey, Source, Destination, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m)
| order by SeriesKey asc, Bucket asc
| serialize
| extend PrevKey = prev(SeriesKey), PrevCounter = prev(Counter)
| where PrevKey == SeriesKey and Counter >= PrevCounter
| summarize Bytes = sum(Counter - PrevCounter) by Source, Destination
| where Bytes > 0
| order by Bytes desc
| take 25

panels.title: Top talkers touching ${namespace}

panels.description: Mean of obi.stat.tcp.rtt over each interval, for connections with ${workload} on either end. RTT is measured from the TCP handshake, so it reflects network latency rather than application latency.

targets.query:
OTELMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where MetricName in ("obi.stat.tcp.rtt_sum", "obi.stat.tcp.rtt_count")
| extend SrcNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.namespace"])
| extend SrcWorkload = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.owner.name"])
| extend DstNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.namespace"])
| extend DstWorkload = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.owner.name"])
| extend NodeID = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["host.id"])
| where (SrcNamespace == "${namespace}" and SrcWorkload == "${workload}") or (DstNamespace == "${namespace}" and DstWorkload == "${workload}")
| extend Edge = strcat(SrcNamespace, "/", SrcWorkload, " -> ", DstNamespace, "/", DstWorkload)
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(MetricName, "|", NodeID, "|", Edge)
| summarize Counter = max(MetricValue) by MetricName, SeriesKey, Edge, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m)
| order by SeriesKey asc, Bucket asc
| serialize
| extend PrevKey = prev(SeriesKey), PrevCounter = prev(Counter)
| where PrevKey == SeriesKey and Counter >= PrevCounter
| extend Delta = Counter - PrevCounter
| summarize DurationSum = sumif(Delta, MetricName endswith "_sum"), Samples = sumif(Delta, MetricName endswith "_count") by Timestamp = Bucket, Edge
| where Samples > 0
| project Timestamp, Edge, MeanRoundTripSeconds = DurationSum / Samples
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Mean TCP round trip time for ${workload}

| extend SrcNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.namespace"])

| extend DstWorkload = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.owner.name"])

| extend Edge = strcat(SrcNamespace, "/", SrcWorkload, " -> ", DstNamespace, "/", DstWorkload)
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(NodeID, "|", Edge)

panels.title: Failed TCP connections for ${workload}

panels.description: Pod network error rate as reported by the kubelet (k8s.pod.network.errors), summed over network interfaces. OBI does not expose NIC level error or drop counters.

targets.query:
OTELMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where MetricName == "k8s.pod.network.errors"
| extend NamespaceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["k8s.namespace.name"])
| extend PodName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["k8s.pod.name"])
| extend Interface = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["interface"])
| extend Direction = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["direction"])
| where NamespaceName == "${namespace}"
| extend Series = strcat(PodName, " ", Direction)
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(Series, "|", Interface)
| summarize Counter = max(MetricValue) by SeriesKey, Series, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m)
| order by SeriesKey asc, Bucket asc
| serialize
| extend PrevKey = prev(SeriesKey), PrevCounter = prev(Counter), PrevBucket = prev(Bucket)
| where PrevKey == SeriesKey and Counter >= PrevCounter
| extend Seconds = todouble(datetime_diff('second', Bucket, PrevBucket))
| where Seconds > 0
| summarize ErrorsPerSecond = sum((Counter - PrevCounter) / Seconds) by Timestamp = Bucket, Series
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Pod network errors in ${namespace}

list.definition:
OTELMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where MetricName == "obi.network.flow.bytes"
| mv-expand NamespaceName = pack_array(
    tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.src.namespace"]),
    tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["k8s.dst.namespace"])) to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(NamespaceName)
| distinct NamespaceName
list.label: namespace
list.name: namespace
